name: Tiny Wasp 99
author: Mhyar-nsi
description: Neon rounded sky-blue button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #f3f7fe to #3b82f6, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 5px #3b83f65f, text color changes from #3b82f6 to #fff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tiny Wasp 99</title>
<style>
/* Tiny Wasp 99 by Mhyar-nsi — https://uiverse.io/Mhyar-nsi/tiny-wasp-99 */
button {
  font-family: monospace;
  background-color: #f3f7fe;
  color: #3b82f6;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  width: 100px;
  height: 45px;
  transition: .3s;
}

button:hover {
  background-color: #3b82f6;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #3b83f65f;
  color: #fff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
